sectionDescriptions.Weekend Attendance: We're currently in the heat of summer seasonality, every year we see around a 30% drop in the summer as we're all about our summer camps, trips, and activities.
sectionDescriptions.Baptisms: Baptisms trending toward another record year, as we've seen 38 so far halfway through 2026!
sectionDescriptions.Church Members: Member dates prior to 2024 are estimates. New process saw massive influx in 2025, and we're trending for a record 2026 so far!
sectionDescriptions.Serve Teams: Where we most need volunteers right now — full teams are healthy, gaps are invitations.
sectionDescriptions.Average Giving by Month: Monthly general giving compared to the monthly need line (what we need to hit our $8.5m goal by May 2027)
sectionDescriptions.ALL-IN Pledge Progress: In May of 2026, we were ahead of schedule on our 7.3m goal, and when that increased to 8.5m, we are now on track to overtake the goal again.
sectionDescriptions.Budget Allocation: Where every dollar given actually goes, including each church plant and mission we support.
sectionDescriptions.Community Groups: How many active community groups we have — the front door to real relationships.
sectionDescriptions.Community Group Members: How many people are doing life together in a community group.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: In the last 9 months I’ve observed people’s capacity to serve mainly changes seasonally or due to unforeseen circumstances. With that in mind, I’m targeting 150 conservatively. We may only need around 130 but not certain and still observing.
teamsLeaderForms.more: Nothing that we aren’t already discussing and working on.
teamsLeaderForms.res: None that I can think of
teamsLeaderForms.suc: I haven’t found anyone with that desire but I’m definitely looking. One of my main focuses for team development beyond serving along side them on Sundays, is investing relationships, first with our most faithful volunteers and encouraging them to identify others and repeat. Through that practice, I believe individuals with genuine desire will present themselves.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: There are 5 ppl for setup and 7 for tear down. Tear down is doing great but I feel we struggle with the setup as ppl serve more often than the tear down ppl.
teamsLeaderForms.more:
Thanks for helping with the 🐜 ants!! :-) 
Nothing right now
teamsLeaderForms.res: I should offer the team a training with the Planning Center and Church Center just to make sure they are all equipped- I need to make time to do this.
teamsLeaderForms.suc: Breanne Read - she started serving a few months ago and she is thriving! She shows a lot of joy when serving.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: 2 per service transition x 2 transitions per Sunday. Most willing to serve twice a month, but some also serving on multiple teams. Also would be good to have 2 for callouts.
teamsLeaderForms.suc: Michael France probably could, but he is putting off getting baptized and becoming a member. Tom MacDonald certainly could but don't know if he wants to or how he is with technology. Bill Wallace already tried and backed out due to tech competency/willingness.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: People get sick or go out of town. Some serve 2-3 Sundays, some 1 Sunday.
teamsLeaderForms.more: I cannot think of one at this moment.
teamsLeaderForms.res: Maybe another suggested prayer book to hand out. I have given them "Praying Through The Bible".

teamsLeaderForms.iss: They are short staffed and need to rotate to give the rest of the volunteers a break.
teamsLeaderForms.more: The 11am has volunteers that are currently on vacation during this time of year.
teamsLeaderForms.res: Yes! The offering baskets are a blessing!

teamsLeaderForms.iss: The need for for Moore would be to help out at the 8a service
teamsLeaderForms.more: Hospitality seems to be more of an individual role rather than a team role and I feel like people can feel isolated on this team. Just thinking through that.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: Having 2 serving at every service, vacations and sickness.
teamsLeaderForms.res: More streamlined way of ringing things up.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: If we can get to 20, I feel like that will enable everyone to serve once or twice a month, especially our sound board guys, they serve more than anyone and it’s not easy.
teamsLeaderForms.more: The only issue I can think of is training everyone, which isn’t an issue it just needs to happen. Everyone knows the basics but I feel like I can reiterate the basics of how each Sunday should go, some people create their own ideas (some people open shades when they think they should, despite what the instructions say)
teamsLeaderForms.res: Not that I can think of

teamsLeaderForms.iss: With the extra children in Stepping Stones, it helps to have another person that can do bathroom checks. Ideal, at least for 9:30 and 11:00 is to have 5 safety team members.  One at children door, one in front, one in back, and 2 roamers (parking lot, Yosh's, bathroom checks).
teamsLeaderForms.more: Nothing at the moment.  Planning on a group meeting. Welcome to attend once we have a date set.
teamsLeaderForms.res: At some point  the leaders/pastor need to announce from the stage what to do in case of an active shooter.  We have told the team and will reiterate the plan at the meeting, but need the congregation what they need to do.

teamsLeaderForms.iss: We have a very solid team that works well together, plus not just anyone can serve with students. We always keep our eyes open for more leaders, especially young leaders who are growing up, but they still have some time.
teamsLeaderForms.more: The only issue we come across is leaders and where they want to serve. Some value high school over middle school, which we understand, but we do need leaders in every area.
teamsLeaderForms.res: More room 😂 just like the rest of the church haha

teamsLeaderForms.iss: We have a good flow right now and I don’t think anyone is over burdened by the frequency of serving.
I want to have a team lead and assistant for all your services. This will allow them to manage the teams better.
teamsLeaderForms.more: Just getting more people to serve
teamsLeaderForms.suc: Im the team overseer and have built up 6 leaders and have added another who confirmed on Sunday. Tim Martin wants to be a leader.
